Explicit cache and implicit cache are mutually exclusive.

Explicit-cache creation costs 125% of the standard input token price and hits cost 10% of the standard input token price. Implicit-cache hits normally cost 20% of the standard input token price. The deepseek-v4-pro cached-token price is not 20%; use the console price.

OpenAI-compatible and DashScope responses report cached_tokens and prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation_input_tokens. Anthropic-compatible responses expose "input_tokens", "output_tokens", cache_read_input_tokens, and cache_creation_input_tokens. Batch file calls are not eligible for cache discounts.
